latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the mimo skill, providing foundational and advanced MIMO knowledge:

- Equips users with the ability to explain spatial multiplexing, diversity, and architectural concepts in MIMO systems.
- Details distinctions between SU-MIMO, MU-MIMO, and Massive MIMO, including channel matrix usage, beamforming, and precoding.
- Outlines performance metrics such as spectral efficiency, diversity gain, and multiplexing gain.
- Addresses key implementation challenges including channel estimation, antenna correlation, and hardware complexity.
- Includes common troubleshooting guidance and misconceptions.
- Suggests extensions into hybrid beamforming, cell-free architectures, and reconfigurable intelligent surfaces.
